text:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing GA acceptance principles + an exemption path. Need signoff on SLA thresholds, docs scope, support model, monitoring signals, and pricing gate. Can we get owners?

alex: I can own SLA thresholds and rollout plan. Quick question: do we treat Dedicated and Hosted separately for SLAs?

maria: Yes. Hosted gets full SLA. Dedicated pilot customers get a narrower SLA for the first 90 days unless they opt-in. Details below.

jordan: Monitoring/ops: we need concrete SLI targets to instrument. Proposing token-gen latency and 5xx rate as primary.

maria: Proposed minimums (for Hosted GA):
```
- latency.p50 < 80ms
- latency.p95 < 200ms
- latency.p99 < 500ms
- errors.http5xx_rate < 0.1%
- inference_timeouts < 0.01%
``` 
Are these acceptable?

alex: p95/p99 look reasonable for our small-seq baseline. Need note: longer contexts will change distribution — add sequence-length buckets in dashboards.

jordan: Agreed. We'll add buckets: short (<256 tokens), mid (256–1024), long (>1024). Also add KV cache hit ratio metric for default models.

sam: Pricing gate: we need the GA unit pricing finalized before signoff. Two asks: 1) cost-per-token estimates for typical workloads; 2) surge cap behaviour for free-tier trials.

maria: @sam can you confirm latest pricing matrix by EOD tomorrow? Also propose a temporary surge cap: limit trial accounts to 100k tokens/day or auto-apply billing hold.

sam: I can confirm numbers by EOD. 100k/day cap makes sense for trials. For enterprise pilots we can whitelist with finance approval.

pat: Docs checklist: Quickstart, Runbook for oncall, SLA page (with clear exceptions), Migration guide for Dedicated -> Hosted, and a FAQ for pricing/caps.

maria: Exemption process (pilot customers / early adopters): short lived, formal review + risk signoff. Draft policy:
```
- Exemption window: up to 90 days from GA
- Request: product-exempt form + justification
- Approvers: Eng Lead + SRE + FinOps
- Requirements: telemetry hook installed, monthly review call
``` 

alex: Approve that flow. Add a clause: if exemptions cause measurable ops risk > X, we pull the exemption.

jordan: We should instrument a smoke test that runs every deploy for exempted tenants and alerts on regressions.

maria: Ownership summary:
- SLA thresholds + rollout: alex
- Monitoring dashboards + alerts: jordan
- Pricing & surge caps: sam
- Docs + runbooks: pat
- Exemption approvals: product (maria) + eng review

maria: Final asks before signoff: everyone acknowledge by EOD. If any objections, raise them here. Otherwise we'll mark this thread as the record and start updating the checklist.

alex: :white_check_mark: ack

jordan: :white_check_mark: ack

pat: :white_check_mark: ack

sam: :white_check_mark: ack, will upload pricing matrix

deploy-bot: Rollout plan draft uploaded to /internal/launch-playbooks/ga-rollout-v1

maria: Thanks — I'll file the acceptance doc and link to this thread in the playbook. If any follow-ups, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
